title: AppSheet Automation | Google Cloud
description: Reclaim time and talent with no-code apps and automation.

sections.heading: Focus on impact
paragraphs: Reclaim time for high-impact work rather than manual tasks.

sections.heading: Reduce context switching
paragraphs: Build automations and applications on a unified platform.

sections.heading: Improve collaboration
paragraphs: Streamline processes, such as approvals and onboarding, across your organization.

sections.heading: Intelligent document processing
paragraphs: Leverage the power of Google Cloud Document AI to automatically extract data from unstructured sources like W-9s and receipts to run processes more efficiently.

sections.heading: Data change events
paragraphs: Configure bots to detect data changes on work in concert with external sources, such as Google Sheets and salesforce, to trigger processes and approvals.

sections.heading: Modularity
paragraphs: Create automation bots from completely reusable components—events, processes, and tasks.

sections.heading: Seamless connectivity
paragraphs: Connect directly with APIs, data sources, webhooks, and legacy software, or use data export to export, back up, or sync application data with external platforms.
